hero.title: MenteBonita

before_items.b1: Manual scheduling of mindfulness sessions with specialists, leading to errors and calendar conflicts
before_items.b2: Scattered communication between patients, specialists, and administrators with no unified channel
before_items.b3: Billing and payment tracking handled in spreadsheets, with no real audit trail
before_items.b4: No efficient way to scale the business model to multiple organizations (B2B)

m1.label: of admin time spent on repetitive, manual tasks

m2.label: growth due to lack of scalable technology infrastructure

m3.label: user experience across patients, specialists, and companies

solution.title: 360 Multi-tenant Platform
solution.subtitle: We designed and built an end-to-end platform that centralizes the management of mental wellness services, letting multiple organizations operate independently on top of shared infrastructure.

c1.title: Smart Scheduling
c1.desc: Real-time booking with dynamic specialist availability, conflict prevention, and automatic email notifications.

c2.title: Integrated Video Calls
c2.desc: Mindfulness sessions via video with the AWS Chime SDK — no external apps needed — plus dynamic rooms and optional recording.

c3.title: Multi-tenant Architecture
c3.desc: Every organization runs with isolated data on a single deployment, with custom branding, roles, and granular permissions.

f1.title: Notification System
f1.desc: Transactional emails via SES and async queues via SQS for reminders and confirmations

f2.title: Specialist Dashboard
f2.desc: Complete panel to manage the calendar, patients, session history, and performance metrics

f3.title: B2B Corporate Portal
f3.desc: Dedicated interface for companies to manage employees, plans, and service usage reports

f4.title: Unified Experience
f4.desc: Consistent flow for patients, specialists, and administrators from a single application

stack.title: Enterprise Technology Stack

frontend.angular: Core framework with standalone components, signals, and lazy loading for top-tier performance
frontend.rxjs: Reactive programming for state management, async flows, and real-time communication

backend.nestjs: Modular architecture with dependency injection, guards, interceptors, and robust validation
backend.postgres: Relational database with per-tenant schemas, automated migrations, and backups

infra.chime: Real-time video calls with dynamic rooms and participant management
infra.sqs: Message queues for async processing of notifications and events
infra.ses: Transactional email service for confirmations, reminders, and communications
infra.ec2: Containerized deployment with auto-scaling and high availability
infra.rds: Managed database with read replicas and automatic failover
infra.cloudwatch: Centralized monitoring with metrics, logs, and alarms for 24/7 operations

stack.arch_desc: Every organization runs with fully isolated data on top of shared infrastructure — optimizing cost and simplifying maintenance.

m1.label: digitization of scheduling, sessions, and billing operations

m2.label: dual business model that sells to companies and end users simultaneously

m3.label: complete coverage of the mental wellness service lifecycle

achievements.a1: Production-ready multi-tenant platform serving multiple organizations with complete data isolation
achievements.a2: Native video-call integration eliminating the need for external tools like Zoom or Meet
achievements.a3: Async notification system that processes thousands of emails without impacting app performance
achievements.a4: Architecture ready to scale horizontally with predictable cost and simplified maintenance
